title: Install an engine thermostat with its jiggle valve clocked to 12 o'clock, seat the perimeter gasket, and fit the housing cover
instruction: Take the engine thermostat from its staging tray, seat it in the coolant housing counterbore with its brass jiggle valve clocked to the 12 o'clock position, press the perimeter rubber gasket into the sealing groove, and lower the water neck housing cover flush onto the guide studs.
context: Automotive service technicians and mechanics (SOC 49-3023, 760,000+ US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) regularly replace engine thermostats during scheduled cooling system servicing, water pump replacements, and diagnostic overheating repairs. OEM service manuals strictly require clocking the thermostat's brass air-bleed jiggle valve to the highest vertical point (12 o'clock position within +-15 degrees) so trapped air bleeds past the closed thermostat during coolant refill; misorientation traps air pockets in the cylinder head, causing localized hot spots and catastrophic engine overheating. The perimeter rubber gasket must be seated flush in the counterbore groove, and the aluminum water outlet cover must be lowered over dual guide studs without cocking to ensure a leak-tight seal before torquing fasteners.
setup: Dual YAM arm station (table deck z=0.7475 m). Cast aluminum engine block coolant housing fixture at (0.26, 0.0, z=0.7475 m) with 56 mm counterbore recess (6 mm deep, seat z=0.7815 m) and dual vertical M8 guide studs at x=0.260 +- 0.035 m (extending 24 mm to z=0.8115 m). 54 mm automotive thermostat (Stant 13359 / Gates 33008 style, 85 g) upright in pocket tray at (0.22, -0.16 m) with brass jiggle pin offset 18 mm radially. Molded nitrile rubber perimeter gasket (54 mm ID x 62 mm OD x 3 mm) on stand at (0.22, 0.16 m). Cast aluminum 90-degree water outlet neck cover (120 g, 9 mm clearance holes at +-35 mm) on cradle at (0.28, 0.16 m). Both parallel grippers start in READY position.
scoring: 0 if thermostat is dropped on table deck or placed inverted. Otherwise: 0.25 if thermostat is lifted from tray and carried over housing; 0.50 if thermostat is seated in housing counterbore recess with jiggle valve clocked within +-15 degrees of 12 o'clock (+Y); 0.75 if perimeter rubber gasket is seated flush over thermostat flange in groove; 1.0 if housing cover is seated flush over studs onto gasket (<1.0 mm gap) and both grippers are retracted clear (>20 mm), held motionless for 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Lift housing cover off studs and return to cradle; lift gasket from counterbore and return to stand; lift thermostat from housing recess and return upright to staging tray.
fidelity: Rigid bodies in PhysX (240 Hz). Octagonal box approximations reproduce round cylindrical thermostat flange, wax pellet body, annular rubber gasket, and housing counterbore. Kinematics verified with physical seating catches. Scorer enforces defect gating on table drop or inverted installation, precise +-15 deg rotational alignment for the 12 o'clock air bleed jiggle valve, and flush seating (<1.0 mm gap) of water outlet cover over dual guide studs.
